_comment: The Signal Field. Four capabilities, each holding technologies, each technology
pointing at the work where it was actually used.
`project` must match a slug in projects.json, or be null.
Only list things that appear in the resume, the old site, or shipped work.
The visualisation draws the connections; it does not invent them.
